scope: Read-only audit of the App Store Connect draft and public ASO tools. No listing edits or review submission.

verifiedLive.subtitle: E85 & Diesel Station Finder

freeToolsUsed.name: Appstro Metadata Checker
freeToolsUsed.result: No issues found for live name, subtitle, keywords and promotional text. Name 30/30; subtitle 27/30; keywords 100/100; promo 112/170. 16 unique keyword tokens. Description was inspected directly, not entered into this tool.

freeToolsUsed.name: Appstro live keyword research
freeToolsUsed.result: diesel fuel prices difficulty42; diesel fuel finder43; broad diesel62. Relevant search results included GasBuddy, Mudflap, Fuelbook, Diesel Near Me. Scores are proprietary heuristics, not Apple volume or rank predictions.

freeToolsUsed.name: AppDrift autocomplete
freeToolsUsed.result: 18 suggestions from27/27 lists; relevant Spanish terms include gasolina precio and gasolina barata. Many other suggestions are branded or irrelevant. Autocomplete provides no search-volume estimates.

priorities.finding: Support URL blank; public policy predates research and describes conditional server storage rather than actual research collection, motion and visit labels, retention and in-app server deletion. Contact section refers to an app/store contact rather than providing one. Content rights declaration unfinished.
priorities.action: Publish a working support page/contact and accurate updated privacy policy; complete rights declaration only after owner confirms provider/brand permissions. Retain truthful privacy labels.

priorities.finding: Only English US listing despite seven app languages in source documentation.
priorities.action: Start with Spanish Mexico listing localization for US users, including natural local keywords and screenshots; preserve US-only availability. Then Chinese and remaining supported App Store locales after editorial QA.

priorities.finding: Promo and description lead with a generic comparison feature. No-account benefit appears in reviewer notes but not public copy.
priorities.action: Lead with nearby reported prices, E85 discovery and no account requirement. Proposed opening: Find cheaper gas nearby, including E85 and diesel. Compare reported prices on a simple map, with no account required. Keep research optional and explain it accurately.
Test core tasks against Apple's feature criteria before publishing support labels; native components alone do not prove VoiceOver, Larger Text or Reduced Motion support.

priorities.finding: No product-page tests shown; source search in src, modules and ios/FuelUp found no requestReview/StoreReview/store-review/requestRating matches. This search is not proof that no alternative review integration exists.
priorities.action: After launch, measure search impressions, product-page views and downloads by source. Run one Apple product-page experiment at a time when sufficient traffic exists. Add an appropriate native review prompt after a successful user experience if absent; do not tie beta benefits to ratings.

priorities.finding: Marketing URL blank; existing public site is a privacy page.
priorities.action: Create a small clear landing page with product benefits, screenshots, download link and support/privacy links. Later use tailored E85 or diesel custom product pages for relevant outreach; these are optional, not launch blockers.

priorities.finding: Four current screenshots attached on inspected slot; zero preview videos.
priorities.action: Do not add filler to reach ten screenshots. An optional short real-app video can show map interactions, but test whether it improves conversion. Existing artwork is a baseline, not a proven maximum-conversion winner.

Upside.focus: Cash back on gas, groceries and dining

competitorPositioning.recommendation: Emphasize Fuel Up's simple map, fuel-specific discovery and no-account comparison; do not imply cashback, guaranteed savings, or verified pump truth.

limitations: No paid tools/accounts created; no ranking or conversion lift measured.
